_about: Embraer EMB-145 (ERJ-145 EP/ER/EU/MP/MK/LR/LU), APM-145/1100 Rev 16 (Nov 29/24), Figure 2.2.1 Airplane General Dimensions: page index 19, layers.py --mode strokes --color 0,0,0 at scale 16, clip 65,88,470,185 (side). A T-tail: the tailplane is drawn edge-on over the fin's top fairing; the fin's trailing edge runs up to the fairing's tail and along its top. The crown runs behind the nacelle (hidden); the dorsal fillet leaves the nacelle's top.
